TERMINATION AGREEMENT 
 
 
 This termination agreement ( “Termination Agreement ” ) is made and entered on [●] day of [●], 2018 at Lahore between 
 
 
 MR. MUNAWAR HUSSAIN MALIK son of Mr. Barkat Ali, resident of House No. 125, Sector Z, Phase III, Defence Housing Authority (DHA), Lahore, Pakistan, bearing CNIC No. 35201-3781284 (hereinafter referred to as the “Landlord” which term shall, wherever the context so permits or requires, means and includes his successors-in-interest, legal heirs and assigns) 
 
 AND 
 
 M/S IMZEE CONSULTING (PRIVATE) LIMITED , a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan and having its registered office at 94-B/I, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore (hereinafter referred to as the “Tenant” which term shall, wherever the context so requires or permits, means and includes its successors-in-interest and assigns) through its duly authorized representative. 
 
 Each a “Party” and, collectively, “Parties” . 
 
 WHEREAS: 
 
 The Landlord through Rent Agreement dated [●] December, 2016, registered with Rent Registrar Lahore (“ Rent A greement ”) had rented out the first floor measuring 2 , 500 square feet situat ed at Pearl One, 94-B/I, M.M. Ala m Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, (“ Rented Premises ”) to the Tenant. 
 
 Landlord and Tenant are desirous of terminating the Rent Agreement , which shall be terminated in consideration of the mutual covenants and in accordance with the terms and conditions set forth herein. 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows : 
 
 The Parties mutually agree to terminate the Rent Agreement with effect from 1 st February, 2019 (“ Termination Date” ) . 
 
 The Parties acknowledge that the Tenant has already paid rent for the Rented Premises until the period ending 31 st January, 2019 , wherein half-yearly rent for the current period commencing 1 st August 2018 to 31 st January 2019 was paid vide c heque No.00000810 dated 28.8.2018 drawn on Habib Bank Limited , Z Block Branch DHA , Lahore Cantt , in the amount of Rs . 2,368,000 (Rupees two million, three hundred and sixty-eight thousand) in favor of Munawar Hussain Malik (Landlord) . 
 
 The L andlord, upon inspection of the Rented Premises , hereby confirms that the Rented Premises is in good order and condition and free of any damage and shall , on the Termination Date, refund the complete security deposit to the Tenant of Rs.1 ,237,500 (Rupees o ne million, two hundred and thirty seven thousand and five hundred) paid vide c heque No. 00000129 dated 15.12. 2016 drawn on Habib Bank Limited , Z Block DHA Branch, Lahore Cantt . , in favor of Munawar Hussain Malik. 
 
 The Parties acknowledge that the Rent Agreement shall stand terminated as on the Termination Date, and upon refund of security deposit as per Clause 3 of this Termination Agreement, and neither Party shall have any further rights or obligations whatsoever under the Rent Agreement. 
 
 The Parties, their employees, agents, sub-contractors, successors and assigns, hereby discharge and release each other from any and all claims, demands, obligations, liabilities, or causes of action, whether known or unknown, arising out of or relating to the Rent Agreement. 
 
 This Termination Agreement i s the entire agreement between the Parties and supersedes any and all prior agreements and understandings between the P arties , whether written or oral . 
 
 
 IN WITNESSS WHEREOF , the Parties hereto have executed this Termination Agreement , on the day, month and year mentioned above. 
 
 
 For and on behalf of Landlord For and on behalf of Tenant
